_comment: 练功演出 (DECISIONS「练功演出」): what a continuous 练习 / 请教 / 打坐 / 冥思 / 修行 shows on the map while its window steps aside, and the 成长时刻 a gain is marked with. Presentation only: nothing here changes a rule, a cost or what is saved. Durations of the stage and of a moment are pacing.json's feel (training_stage_ms, growth_moment_ms: 0 none).

training._comment: zoom: the camera's push-in on the one training (WorldVoxelView.set_zoom: 1 the map's own, smaller closer) over zoom_seconds. round: seconds one stroke (or one dodge, one parry) takes, rest included; teacher_lead: how far ahead of the pupil a master shows the same stroke. trail: the weapon leaves its light, in the school's colour (battle_stage.json schools). whoosh_db: how loud a stroke's whoosh is (the fight's is 0). forms: how a skill is shown, by the use it is practised as or, for 请教, the first use the skill serves (a weapon's use is a stroke with that weapon and needs no entry) — form strike (weapon: the weapon's skill, "" bare hands), react (react: VoxelPerson.REACTIONS dodge / parry), sit (cross-legged, the 气 about it) or study (the master talks, the pupil listens); default: any other. cultivation: the colour of the 气 by what is cultivated. sit: the art about one seated (BattleArts.KINDS), how often it rises (every) and how long one lasts (seconds), the light on the figure. min_seconds: the least the stage stands, from the window stepping aside (a run of a few steps is over in half a second: the figure is given the time for a stroke). hold: seconds the stage stays once the run stops — plain, or `moment` shares of the feel's growth_moment_ms when the run ended on a gain (a level, a maximum).

moments._comment: 成长时刻: read off the player's own state every check_seconds (GrowthWatch): a skill's level, a skill first learned, a maximum of 内力 / 法力 / 灵力 raised, a master taken, a quest ended, a story's thing (items.json `quest`) first come by. More than `bulk` of one kind at once is a set-up, not a gain: none is shown. At most `queue` wait their turn (the oldest small ones make way). A moment is a brush stroke with its words at `y` of the screen's height and, on the player's figure, an art (BattleArts.KINDS) in `colour` with a light; during a fight they wait for its end. kinds: tier (tiers: seconds as a share of the feel's growth_moment_ms, the stroke's size, the words' size), stroke and ink (the stroke's and the words' colours), art, colour, sound (BattleSounds: seal / clapper / gong / drum …, pitch, db), pose (VoxelPerson.REACTIONS, held while it shows).
